check_is_keyword: check if a given token is a C++ keyword using IsKeyword
check_is_builtin_type: check if a given token is a C++ builtin type using IsBuiltinType
list_cpp_types: list all C++ type keywords from the TYPES set
list_cpp_control_keywords: list all C++ control flow keywords from the CONTROL set
list_all_cpp_keywords: list all C++ keywords from the ALL set
